ReactOS 0.4.1: The elder scrolls V Skyrim
I didn't know where else to post this. The sound doesn't work yet (an issue with ReactOS) but I think this shows promise for ReactOS as a gaming platform.
That's insane. I remember when this project was just starting, now it runs skyrim. (without sound)

Yeah, recent commits have added support for EXT3 and ReiserFS. The other day I loaded up ReactOS in a virtual machine and for the first time I didn't have any issues with the interface. Things are really starting to mature.

ReactOS is still a very long ways away from being ready for prime time, and will likely never achieve parity with modern Windows builds. It's been 20 years and it's still not even close to ready to compete with Windows 95. It's cool that the project is still moving, but it's so feature incomplete that I don't think Skyrim would really run without extreme problems. Keep in mind we only saw the opening sequence at a reduced resolution in windowed mode (and most likely not hardware accelerated at all) and it was dropping frames all over the place. I can only imagine what kind of fun a person will have trying to get drivers for their hardware to work.

Even ignoring the missing audio, I'm entirely certain that trying to play the game on that OS would be an exercise in pain.
Yes. It's still impressive even if its not ready.

Actually, the opening sequence is one of the hardest things to run in the game. Even small mods unrelated to the intro can mess up the intro's delicately scripted sequence on Windows.

Skyrim also drops frames like crazy in Windows. It's a terribly unoptimized game, especially unmodded.

If it wasn't hardware accelerated, it wouldn't run at all.

In other words, the fact that it runs that well is truly remarkable.
